name: 零延迟长续航通话头戴耳麦款
description: 深炭薄荷青视觉体系，零延迟长续航与带麦通话主线的头戴耳麦详情套图

styleLock.direction: dark-and-light alternating premium tech audio ecommerce
styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating full-bleed deep charcoal #2E3338 and clean white or light ice-grey #E9EFF1 sections, soft vignettes, subtle geometric shapes such as soft spheres, a matte round podium and glowing ring motifs
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft studio key light with gentle rim light on dark screens, bright even high-key light on light screens, soft contact shadows, neutral-cool 5000-5500K
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte dark podium disc, matte light-grey desk corner, seamless studio backdrop
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; thin light-grey English eyebrow line above every headline; white headlines on dark screens, charcoal #2D2D2D headlines on light screens
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line white icons inside circular neumorphic badges; small circular pin callouts in accent #5FE0C8
styleLock.presentationRules: product centered with stable scale; consistent front 3/4 hero angle for packshots; product always grounded with a soft contact shadow, never floating; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dark-and-light alternating premium tech audio ecommerce visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of deep charcoal background #2E3338, pure white #FFFFFF, light ice-grey section background #E9EFF1, and a single mint-cyan accent #5FE0C8 for badges, glow rings, callout pins and stat highlights; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif typography with a thin light-grey English eyebrow line above every headline; alternating full-bleed deep charcoal and clean white or light ice-grey sections with soft vignettes and subtle geometric shapes such as soft spheres, a matte round podium and glowing ring motifs; soft studio key light with gentle rim light on dark screens and bright even high-key light on light screens, soft contact shadows so the product never floats; thin-line white icons inside circular neumorphic badges and small circular pin callouts in the accent color; product centered with stable scale and a consistent front 3/4 hero angle for packshots; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no exaggerated glow effects.

provenance.notes: 10 张 800×1200 切片按序拼合分析。源页为混拼素材：主视觉为白色带麦头戴耳麦（真零延迟/长续航卖点），但页内混入黑色LED头戴耳机、白金色无线头戴耳机照片及真无线充电仓文案（收纳仓/充电盒），模板只提取版式与视觉语法，产品一律以 {product} 占位。已剥离源页二维码水印、会员角标与『产品参数』中具体数值（蓝牙5.0/20米/10小时/300mah 等不可验证主张），规格与续航数字一律走 {callout} 文案槽由使用方填写，不发明数据。源图六个功能图标标签全部雷同，已重建为六个独立 {callout} 文案槽。
